items.text: No more gambling at the Altar. The die you place now shows its result in advance, and confirming gives you exactly that.
Every visit upgrades the die by +1, even without a ritual (up to 9).
Gold ritual: another +1, paid in gold - the higher the die, the higher the price (5 to 35).
Health ritual: another +1 for the same price in HP. It never takes your last HP.
Destruction ritual: sacrifice one other die to get a copy of the upgraded one. The die on the Altar is never lost.
Rituals stack - combine Gold and Health for +3 in a single visit.
Bad outcomes are gone: no more “nothing happens”, no -1, no losing the die.
This rebalance frees up the reward slot that healing used to take, so your rewards now offer more of the runes, relics and dice you actually need.
Skip adapts to you: below half HP, skipping heals you; at half or more, it pays gold.
The Heal card and Max HP increase are no longer offered after battles, in any mode - Skip now covers healing, so that slot goes to relics and dice.
Miniboss rewards in Adventure come in two steps: first a class relic (pick 1 of 3), then tier 4 dice. Your build starts taking shape much earlier.
One reroll per reward window, so multi-step rewards give you a reroll on each.
Pick your boss with a click: on the location screen, boss portraits are now clickable - click one to choose the boss you will face in your Adventure run.
Fixed text overflow in the Almanac.
The achievement popup now fits the new Handjet font.
The map no longer branches into two identical non-combat nodes side by side (like two shops).
Fixed runes not correctly detecting which dice are inside their radius.
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3542380/Rune_Dice/"]
We’ve just released a new patch! Check it out below.

Flag the map. Click any node on the minimap to mark it with a red flag, click again to remove it. Mark as many as you like - the flags also show up on the world map, so the route you planned is always in front of you.
Random Hero. Can’t decide who to take? A new button next to “Start” on the hero select screen picks one of your unlocked heroes for you.
Rune preview. While you apply a rune, the dice it will affect are outlined, so you see exactly what changes before you confirm.
Enemy names on hover. Hover over an enemy in battle to see its name.
Boss names on the location screen. The selected boss’s name now appears under its portrait in “Choose a boss”.
Reward pick animation. Picking a reward now has a proper moment - your choice animates and the rest fly off the screen.
German, French, Spanish, Italian, Portuguese (Brazil), Czech, Turkish, Vietnamese, Ukrainian, and Russian now use a new pixelated font.
Fixed the master die sometimes disappearing right after the throw - at certain angles it bounced off the bottom edge instead of flying up the board.
Boss icons on the location screen now all share the same outline style.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45508453/ce00da1f6fce5d40c19e517ada10c2ed086822f6.png"]

notes.title: A brutal, one-way descent, with nothing but mini-boss and boss fights floor after floor. There are twenty floors in total, each harder than the last, ending with three bosses at once.

items.text: Reward dice can drop from any class - not just the one you are playing. Mix a Mage die into a Paladin run and see what happens. That freedom is the whole point of the mode.
Every win gives you two reward picks, and you can reroll as much as your gold allows.
Every class keeps its own record - your Deepest Floor Cleared, shown right on the mode screen.

notes.title: One shop, one boss, one chance. Spend your coins, then face a single boss that never stops summoning reinforcements. This is a mode built for experimenting and having fun.

items.text: Set your coin budget with a slider, from Broke Genius at the bottom to Rich Baron at the top.
Pick your boss, then build for it. The shop offers only dice and relics, rerolls are free, and selling refunds the full price - dig until you have exactly the build you want.

The budget is the score. Beating a boss is step one. Beating it again for fewer coins is the mode. High up the slider it is a sandbox: buy everything, break the board. Down at the bottom it turns into a puzzle - one build, no slack, no room for a wasted coin.
Lost? Replay Battle restarts the same fight against the same boss straight from the defeat screen, with the build you already bought.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45508453/28b36e06b8e36d16f3128166b2466f8cc20adfec.gif"]

Reward screens no longer show you the same thing twice. A relic or rune already offered on that screen will not come back - rerolls and the second pick included. Dice count as the same only when both the die type and its face value match, so the same die at a different value can still turn up. A new chest, boss or node starts fresh.

Shop rerolls stopped repeating themselves too. Relics and runes already shown during this shop visit stay out of the reroll. Dice are unaffected here. If the pool genuinely runs out of unique items, it resets, so an offer slot is never left empty.

Skipping a reward after a boss or miniboss now gives you +15 HP instead of gold - in Classic and after every boss in Boss Rush. The Skip icon turns into a heart, and the healing reward drops out of that offer pool, so you are no longer choosing between the heal you need and the relic you want. Healing is capped at your max HP. Chests, regular fights and Skirmish are unchanged: Skip still gives gold there.
Four More Languages. Rune Dice is now playable in Turkish, Italian, Czech and Vietnamese.

notes.title: We can’t wait to see your dice work in these new modes, share your runs with us on Discord! Remember, if you find any bugs or have feedback, you can post in our Steam Forums or dedicated Discord channels.

items.text: [dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3542380/Rune_Dice/"]
Time Mirror - 2 seconds after you throw, a copy of your throwing die launches from the same spot along the same path. Unlocks by collecting 20 dice in a single run.
Chameleon Mask - 50% chance your throwing die becomes a Chameleon die. When it merges, it becomes the same type as whatever it merged with. Unlocks by dealing 1000 damage.
A splash screen now shows the upcoming boss when a location map loads - at the start of a run, and for Classic Mode, at the start of each of its three location loads.
Veilstone Amulet Reworked. Now grants 1 ward at the start of each turn for every enemy on the field with a magical attack (previously granted 2 wards once, on entering combat).
Lowered the cost of several relics.
Small Altar fix - it occasionally showed the wrong value.

notes.title: A full bomb build is now possible 💣

items.text: Three new relics turn Bomb Dice from a nice surprise into a strategy:
Blasting Powder - explosions from Bomb Dice have 50% greater range and force.
Booster Charge - Bomb Dice deal double damage.
Chain Detonator - when an explosion hits another Bomb Die, that one detonates too. Chain reactions across the whole board.
All three also work on Big Bada Boom.
Spring Coil II - merged dice jump even higher and are pulled toward their targets more strongly.
Spring Coil III - maximum jump height and maximum pull. The first tier III relic in the game.
Relief Rune - fully removes one random negative effect from your hero.
Retribution Censer (Paladin) - when your hero gains fire, the same amount of fire is applied to a random enemy.
New relics and the new rune are unlocked through play, like the rest.
Classic Hardcore rerolls are cheaper. Shop rerolls cost less across all three acts, and reward rerolls now match the costs used in regular Classic.

The bottom edge of the board is now a solid wall. Dice that reach it bounce off instead of being lost, exactly like the other three edges. With explosions throwing dice around, far too many runs were quietly losing dice off the bottom of the screen.
Merge physics: chain merges no longer freeze or veer off nearby dice you knocked on purpose. Only dice thrown outward by the merge itself get damped, so a deliberate bump keeps its trajectory.
Fixed a dead zone in board input - dice could not be thrown by clicking in the right part of the board, with a smaller unresponsive area on the left. The full board now responds.

Hard Mode completions now count as Normal Mode completions. No more clearing the same boss twice - the trophy tooltip also lists every class that beat that boss on Hard. Applies retroactively to your existing save, no new runs needed.
The location screen is now split into Adventures and Game Modes, so it stays readable as more ways to play arrive.
Goblin Warchief now has a chance to summon Archers instead of only melee units.

Bowman's Pauldron reworked - it now triggers whenever a Knockback Die hits an enemy with another enemy directly behind it, instead of requiring an actual push. It works on targets that cannot be pushed, such as a stunned boss. Each of the two enemies now takes damage equal to the other's attack value.
Phoenix Essence now reads correctly: the Healing Die fully removes one negative effect from the hero, rather than a single stack of it.

End Game Coins and End Game Healer no longer use the ambiguous word "discarded" - they now say plainly that each die left in the dice queue when combat ends grants a coin, or heals the hero for 1. Behaviour is unchanged.
Upgraded (II) relics now state "Replaces the base relic if you already have it."
The usage hint on every rune is shorter and clearer: "Drag onto the game field during combat to use."
Steam Deck: fixed a softlock when opening the in-game Settings menu at certain low resolutions.
Steam Deck: fixed black borders appearing after resolution settings synced over from PC via cloud save.
Steam Deck resolution no longer carries over to your PC - previously PC would pick up the Deck's resolution after you played there, forcing a manual reset each time.
Fixed attack counter for hero failing to reset after merging 'Inspiration' die with a non-attack die and activating 'Singular Focus' relic ability.
Found and fixed a couple more attack counter miscalculations.
Added a forced reset of the attack score at the end of the dice queue so it reliably shows 0 going into the next round.
Note: Attack counter display is still not fully accurate in most cases - it doesn't account for enemy count on AoE hits or relic damage modifiers yet

New enemy
Wailing Shade
Fixed dice in a tight cluster getting "eaten" by the shot's own collision and losing the merge's magnetic hop - dice now consistently jump over others to reach their target instead of getting stuck.
Fixed a neighboring next-value die (the one your freshly-merged die chains into) getting flung away by the shot's impulse before the merge hop could reach it - close chain merges now land accurately.
Overall, merging feels snappier, stops exactly where it should (no more "slippery" sliding), and big chain reactions resolve reliably up to the max dice count.
Bone Clown

Chaos Purifier reworked: instead of wiping your whole board, at the start of his turn, he now replaces only a limited number of your dice (based on his Purify) with basic dice of the same value - so a wide deck keeps most of what it built.
Now also appears as a boss in Classic Mode.
Sun Cultist
No longer heals himself with regeneration dice. He now throws Sun Fire Dice - merging one sets your hero on fire equal to the die's value.
Blinding Light now hides ALL dice behind "?" (revealed on merge) and scatters Sun Fire Dice across the field.
Faster enemy dice spawn
Enemy dice now spawn faster at combat start and when the field refreshes.
Battle Drum: now correctly deals damage equal to only the Rally gained (it was mistakenly adding the Rally already on your hero).
Classic Mode: the hand-limit slider no longer resets to 12 when returning to the Select Location screen.
Select Location: the difficulty medal now shows the correct mode (Normal/Hard) for the selected hero.
Void Drainers now have their own status icon (was shared with another effect).
Chest Mimic is shifted a bit further right in Classic Mode (Desolate Sands and Void Circus), giving you fewer turns to catch it.
Various description and localization fixes (Tentacle Die, Stone Skin, Life Rune wording).

items.text: Version 0.10.10
🎨 VISUAL IMPROVEMENTS
Merge Feedback Enhancements
Merge visual effects: New colorful effects appear when dice merge - each die type displays its unique color for better visual clarity
Value pop-ups: Merged dice now show their new value in a color-coded pop-up, making it easier to track your combos at a glance
Improved node animations: Map nodes now pulse faster and more prominently, with visual route arrows showing available paths
🎮 GAMEPLAY CHANGES

Precision Aiming: Hold the right trigger to slow down aiming speed for more accurate dice placement - perfect for those clutch throws!

Relics

Upcoming Unlocks: Fixed text translation issues
Enjoy the smoother, more polished experience! 🎲✨

items.text: We are excited to share that we have released a new update to the demo!
Read on to see what has been added.
Version 0.9.12
🌟 MAJOR NEW FEATURES 🌟
New Content
New Class - Warrior: Master a brand new playstyle with unique Warrior dice and class-specific relics!
New Boss - Blight Druid: Face off against this challenging new boss encounter
Meta-Progression System
Unlock system added! Progress now carries between runs - unlock heroes, relics, runes, shop slots, and rune activation slots as you play.
Class Leveling (Levels 1-7): Level up each class to unlock improved starting dice sets (levels 2-6) and gain a powerful relic at level 7.
Quest tracking: New popup after each run shows your newly unlocked content and progress toward future unlocks.
New Altar Node
Risk/Reward dice enhancement: Visit Altar nodes to upgrade or duplicate your dice.
Stack the odds: Improve success chances by paying with coins, health, or sacrificing another die.
New Tutorial
Revamped tutorial system: Complete tutorial redesign to help new players learn the game mechanics more effectively.
Quality of Life Improvements
Better map generation: Cleaner paths with fewer road intersections make navigation easier.
Hard Mode expanded: 3 additional battle rows between the second mini-boss and final boss for more balanced difficulty.
Jester gets own node: Jester encounters now have dedicated nodes for better clarity.
Mimics in chests: Mimics now appear in chest nodes (with some probability) - more thematic!
Improved tooltips: Dice tooltips repositioned so they don't cover the battlefield.
Quick navigation: New quickmap button and game speed controls added to navigation screen.
Smarter pricing: Selling dice and runes now returns 50% of purchase price (instead of flat 5 gold).
Cheaper shop rerolls: Shop reroll cost reduced from 5 to 4 gold.
⚔️ GAMEPLAY CHANGES ⚔️
Combat Mechanics
Refined dice physics: Slightly increased dice jump height (3 → 3.5) and push force (40 → 45) for more dynamic merges.
Damage type overhaul: Clear distinction between Physical, Direct Magical, and Indirect Magical damage.
Boss crowd control update: Control effects now apply to bosses but don't prevent movement - more relics and strategies are viable!
More accurate attack tracking: Hero attack counter reworked for precise calculations.
Dice Changes
Healing Die is now universal: Moved from Mage-exclusive to base category - all classes can use it!
New Mage die - Arcane Die: 50% chance to deal additional damage equal to die value OR 50% chance to heal the hero for die value - high risk, high reward!
Freeze Die rework: Complete redesign with new distribution system and damage-over-time effect.
Backstab Die adjustment: Now deals 1.5x die value (rounded up) instead of previous damage.
Critical Die removed: Streamlined dice pool for better game balance.
Relics and Runes
6 new runes added to expand tactical options.
New Mage relics: Sun Shard and Moon Shard expand Mage strategic options.
Healing Momentum rework: Updated mechanics and description.
Class relics updated: Relics adapted to reflect dice changes.
Balance Changes
Goblin Rider: HP reduced (40 → 30).
Spider boss (Hard Mode): Web Traps increased (2 → 4) for tougher challenge.
Rewards rebalanced: Adjusted heal amounts, max HP gains, and drop chances across the board.
Rune pricing: All rune prices adjusted for better economy.
Life Rune: Heal reduced (15 → 8) for balance.
New Enemy Mechanics
Enemy Shield Die: Enemies can now generate protective shields
Enemy Poison Die: Watch out for poison damage from enemy dice!
🎨 VISUAL & AUDIO ENHANCEMENTS 🎨
Atmosphere
Animated battle backgrounds: Battles feel more alive with dynamic backgrounds.
New ambient sounds: Immersive background audio for different areas.
Expanded soundtrack: New music for boss battles, new track for mini-boss encounters, fresh music for tavern, map screen, and location selection.
Custom damage font: New custom font for damage numbers improves visual clarity
UI Improvements
Redesigned victory/defeat screens: Beautiful new artwork + display of quests closest to completion.
Hard Mode indicators: A separate icon on location selection shows Hard Mode completion status.
Back button: Added to tavern screen for easier navigation.
Tavern trophies: Defeated bosses appear as decorative trophies in the tavern.
Updated sprites: Visual improvements for Goblin Alchemist, Goblin Rider, and various relics (Dice Factory, Reset Bounty).
🔧 TECHNICAL IMPROVEMENTS 🔧
Better button placement: "Continue" and "Exit" buttons swapped in pause menu for more intuitive flow
Clearer effect descriptions: Updated all relic and effect text to properly explain damage types and interactions
Controller/Keyboard improvements: Fixed master dice aim and rune movement speed - no longer dependent on game speed and FPS for consistent controls
Shuffle rune bug fix: Fixed issue with Shuffle rune and spider web interaction
Steam Input fix attempt: Another attempt to resolve Steam Input controller bug

Unfortunately, we have had to reduce the number of languages available in the new demo. We apologize for any inconvenience and disappointment this causes, and we hope to expand the language support in the future.
If you have been enjoying the demo, we’d love to hear your feedback in our Discord channel!

items.text: Then you're in for a treat, because we've added Hard Mode to our demo!

Rebalanced easy battles by reducing the number of ranged enemies

items.text: We've released a small update today for our demo with some important bug fixes and quality-of-life improvements.

notes.title: Here's what's included in the patch

items.text: Fixed an issue where the game would freeze when fighting the Goblin boss with the Infectious Bomb relic - the game would soft lock when boss-summoned units died from poison damage
Unlocked Mage class at game start - you now have two characters (Rogue and Mage) available immediately without needing to defeat a boss first
Reworked upgrade dice popup - much clearer interface when you merge an upgrade die
Better node visibility - inaccessible map nodes now have a distinct visual appearance so you can easily tell which paths you can take
Fixed map generation - improved difficulty distribution so you won't get stuck with only tough battles as your first choice
Fixed button feedback - shop buttons now shake correctly when pressed
Fixed "Highest Dice Merged" stat - now tracks correctly instead of showing 0

We'd like to thank all of our wonderful players for taking the time to submit bug reports and feedback on our demo. Your feedback has been hugely helpful so far! If you have any other feedback you'd like to share, you can fill out our feedback form here.
